tips.title: Pick up where a job left off
tips.body: Stopped a job halfway? Use From Line to resume at any line. ncSender replays the modal state (units, work offset, feed, spindle) up to that line so the machine is set up exactly as it would have been.

tips.title: Save the park spot with a double-tap
tips.body:
Double-tap Park and it turns into Save. Tap once more to store the current position as the parking location. Tap anywhere else, or wait a few seconds, and it goes back to Park without saving.

Hold Park for one second to drive to the saved location.

tips.title: A pulsing Home button means the machine is not homed
tips.body:
When Home pulses, the controller has not run a homing cycle since it powered on, so it does not yet know where the axes are. Hold Home for one second to home; the pulse stops once every axis has found its switch.

Until then, moves that depend on a known position, like Go to Zero, stay locked out.
